static_traits.name: 张昊
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友，但尚not yet向他们分享自己的not自信与not足感；与朋友的互动因Decreased confidence而受到影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without以往心理咨询或治疗经历；without类似心理问题既往史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、思维条理较好，能觉察并讨论自身想法；Neutral attitude，配合度Good，能够进行自我Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 在朋友们have not觉得自己讲的笑话好笑后，对自身“逗笑do not人”的能力产生not足感与Self-doubt；问题加重为害怕被他人评判，认为自己not擅长喜剧，在涉及Humor的社交情境中出现回避与not安全感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些自卑感正在影响自尊与社交互动，希望通过咨询识do not并挑战灾难化与负性预测，形成更现实和平衡的看法，从而提升自信与社交体验。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（not能让do not人发笑就说明我失败）

special_situations.event: 在一次与朋友的聚会上，自己讲的笑话have not引发笑声
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的笑话have not让朋友发笑，就证明我notHumor、我失败了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 降低在朋友面前尝试Humor的频率，避免再讲笑话；向朋友寻求安慰与认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一点也not好笑，我永远都not会擅长喜剧

special_situations.event: 在与朋友一起的轻松娱乐社交场合，需要互动与Humor时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我尝试Humor，do not人会评判我、看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尽量not引人注意、与他人一起随声附和地笑，以避免凸显自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am embarrassing and will evaluate me negatively

special_situations.event: 当想到要讲笑话或看到do not人正在欢笑时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须让所有人都觉得好笑，否则就说明我not行；如果再次尝试，肯定会出丑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在相关情境中沉默、回避主动发言，Reduced socializing暴露
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I say it, the scene will be awkward and everyone will go silent

special_situations.event: Recalling the failed joke-telling experience each time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败就等于我完全not擅长喜剧
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我审查、避免在朋友面前尝试Humor，寻求保证以减轻Anxiety

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被朋友接纳、认可自己的Humor与社交价值
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged, humiliated, and rejected by others
defense_goal: 通过回避Humor表现与降低自我暴露来维持安全感与自尊的完整性

object_relations.self_representation: 容易出丑、缺乏Humor感的被评判者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/可能嘲笑与negate自己的人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites setting a goal of trying again to tell a small joke among friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The unconscious understands the counselor as an authority figure who will push them to expose themselves to embarrassing situations, thereby presuming negative outcomes (transference: negative expectations of others' reactions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和、支持性的语气，先承认其紧张与担忧，再将目标切分为可管理的小步，强调允许not完美与逐步尝试。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当提到朋友可能会‘not觉得好笑’或‘评判自己’的场景时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内心自我批评与羞耻体验Projection为他人的负面评价（认为他人必然看not起自己）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以Empathy性的语气温和纠偏，邀请其区分事实与推测，鼓励举证和多种可能性，避免对抗式质疑。

manifestations: Unmarried且Living alone；在涉及Humor的社交场景中回避表达，感觉‘not被接纳’与‘not属于圈子’
outcomes: 对他人评价的敏感与Anxiety上升

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: In the session, repeatedly assuming that others will evaluate him negatively (such as 'they will think I am awkward')
将内在的羞耻与Self-denial体验理解为do not人的统一看法

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When discussing social goals, is cautious and conservative, tending to set very small attempts to avoid making mistakes
过度在意他人如何看待自己的Humor表现

positive_force: Has several close friends as potential support resources
工作表现not yet受影响，基本生活功能稳定
愿意求助与进行咨询，具备一定的自我觉察与Reflection能力
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括、非黑即白等认知偏误显著
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, tending to seek external recognition and reassurance
在涉及Humor的社交情境中回避与自我审查，导致自尊下滑与互动质量下降

target_behavior.behavior: 在涉及Humor的社交场合回避发言与Humor表达，并通过随声附和来降低存在感
antecedent: At relaxed, entertaining gatherings or social activities with friends
When thinking of telling a joke or seeing others laugh
回忆此前笑话not yet被认为好笑的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 对再次出丑的灾难化预测与‘一次失败=完全not行’的非黑即白信念，以及对他人评判的高度敏感
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and negative evaluation，维持短期安全感与Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem、社交互动受损、Humor表达与自信进一步减少，形成负性循环
